name: Knee Replacement
description: replaces a worn knee joint with a prosthesis to relieve pain and restore movement

name: Bypass Surgery (CABG)
description: reroutes blood around blocked heart arteries using grafts taken from elsewhere in the body

name: Angioplasty & Stenting
description: opens a narrowed artery with a balloon and places a small mesh stent to keep it open

name: Cataract Surgery
description: replaces the clouded natural lens of the eye with a clear artificial lens

name: Hernia Repair
description: closes a weakness in the abdominal wall, often with a supportive mesh

name: Kidney Stone Removal
description: removes or breaks up stones in the kidney or ureter using endoscopic techniques

name: Spine Surgery
description: relieves pressure on nerves in the spine or stabilises unstable vertebrae

name: Hair Transplant
description: moves hair follicles from denser areas of the scalp to thinning areas
